verdict.rationale: Square ships official, first-party SDKs (e.g. square-nodejs-sdk/TypeScript library) with documented code examples for payments, versioning, and client setup, plus broader API coverage (REST, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, sandbox) that AI-native developers can build against, reinforced by an explicit llms.txt/agent-guidance file and an official MCP server for programmatic AI tool access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality beyond GitHub README snippets, and broader multi-language SDK evidence beyond Node/TypeScript.
